risk_if_not_implemented: Without In-Person Validation & Verification, unauthorized individuals, devices or services may gain access to Technology Assets, Applications, Services, Data and/or Facilities (TAASDF). Based on the risk and threat mapping for this control, this deficiency most likely exposes the organization to Unauthorized Access (R-AC-4), Identity Compromise / Impersonation (R-AC-5), and most likely increases susceptibility to Pandemic (Disease) Outbreaks (NT-7); Human Error (MT-9), Fraud, Corruption and/or Intentional Criminal Conduct (MT-14), Workforce Shortage / Loss of Critical Skills / Labor Disruption (MT-25).

compensating_control_1.name: Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA)
compensating_control_1.description:
Automated mechanisms exist to enforce Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA) for:
(1) Remote network access; 
(2) Third-party Technology Assets, Applications and/or Services (TAAS); and/ or
(3) Non-console access to critical TAAS that store, transmit and/or process sensitive and/or regulated data.
compensating_control_1.justification: Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA) (IAC-37) provides access control enforcement that compensates for the absence of In-Person Validation & Verification (IAC-05.4) by restricting system and data access to authorized users through alternative identity and access mechanisms. Given the process-oriented nature of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.

compensating_control_2.name: Identification & Authentication for Organizational Users
compensating_control_2.description: Mechanisms exist to uniquely identify and centrally Authenticate, Authorize and Audit (AAA) organizational users and processes acting on behalf of organizational users.
compensating_control_2.justification: Identification & Authentication for Organizational Users (IAC-32) provides access control enforcement that compensates for the absence of In-Person Validation & Verification (IAC-05.4) by restricting system and data access to authorized users through alternative identity and access mechanisms. Given the process-oriented nature of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.
